title: TV Static
blurb: Analogue television static — the fuzzy grey snow that filled the screen back when a channel had nothing left to give you. A small fraction of that noise was genuinely cosmic microwave background radiation left over from the Big Bang, which is a fantastic thing to tell people at parties. These days it mostly signals horror: dead channels, cursed tapes, and things standing just outside the frame. Reach for it for glitch transitions, found-footage edits, or the precise moment a scene goes wrong.
